1.1.1 Project Need and Objectives
The project will expand treated water distribution capacity for the northern industrial corridor.
Construction is planned over 18 months with commissioning in Q4 2027. Baseline demand is 42 ML/day
and projected demand is 61 ML/day by 2030. The assessment references hydraulic modelling, land-use
constraints, and receptor mapping.

4.6.1 Significance of Effects
Predicted noise impacts remain below the applicable daytime threshold at all monitored receptors.
Residual traffic impacts are moderate during peak construction months and require phased haulage controls.
Mitigation commitments include acoustic barriers, scheduling limits, dust suppression, and monthly monitoring.
